subject: [PATCH v4 04/19] selftests/mm: skip khugepaged page cache cases without a PMD folio

reviews.author: Lorenzo Stoakes (ARM)
reviews.summary: Requested clarification on a comment in the patch, specifically asking to trim it and expressing concerns about inferring file-backed khugepaged behavior from shmem.

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch series addresses issues in the khugepaged selftest, specifically related to page cache folio orders on arm64 architectures. The patch being analyzed introduces a check to skip certain test cases when a PMD-sized page cache folio is impossible due to MAX_PAGECACHE_ORDER limitations.
